का.आ. 1192(अ).-- केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 5.0.138(5) तारीख 10/01/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग 1, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) F प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा त्रिपुरा राज्य के वेस्ट त्रिपुरा जिले में NHB के 
कि.मी. 242.500 से कि.मी.261.610 (वेस्ट त्रिपुरा, अगरतला) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ा करने / चार लेन 
का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन 
करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 2 फ़रवरी, 2024 
को "दैनिक सम्बाद” और "त्रिपुरा ऑब्ज़र्वर” दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी |

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 8th March, 2024 


S.O. 1192(E).—In—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road 
Transport and Highways, S.O.138(E) Dated:10/01/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH8 in the stretch of land from Km. 242.500 to Km. 261.610 (West Tripura, Agartala) in the district of 
West Tripura in the state of TRIPURA; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Sambad” and “Tripura 
Observer” both dated 02.02.2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

New Delhi, the 7th March, 2024 
CMD-2/G-18.—In pursuance of sub-paragraph 2 of paragraph-5 of Scheme-I of Schedule-II of Bureau of 
Indian Standards (Conformity Assessment) Regulations, 2018 and the notification of the Bureau number CMD-2/G- 
18 dated 051 August, 2021, the Bureau hereby makes the following amendments in the said notification which shall 
come into force from the date of this notification, namely:- 
a) In the “SCHEDULE” of the notification of the Bureau number CMD-2/G-18 dated 05th August 2021 read along 
with its amendments including CMD-2/G-18 dated 21st June 2023— 
i) Note 3 shall be substituted namely:- 
“Note 3: Annual minimum marking fee for a micro scale enterprise - From the date of this 
notification till 31 May 2026, a concession of 80% in the annual minimum marking fee payable by the 
large scale enterprises shall be applicable.” 
i) the sub-paragraphs and clauses under Note 3, shall be omitted. 
ii) Note 4 shall be substituted namely:- 
“Note 4: Annual minimum marking fee for a small scale enterprise - From the date of this 
notification till 31 May 2026, a concession of 50% in the annual minimum marking fee payable by the 
large scale enterprises shall be applicable.” 
ili) after Note 4, the following shall be inserted, namely: - 
“Note 5: Annual minimum marking fee for a start-up enterprise - From the date of this 
notification till 31 May 2026, a concession of 80% in the annual minimum marking fee payable by the 
large scale enterprises shall be applicable. 
Note 6: Annual minimum marking fee for a women entrepreneur enterprise - From the date of this notification 
till 31 May 2026, an additional concession of 10% in the annual minimum marking fee payable by the applicable scale 
of enterprises, i.e. either micro or small or medium scale, shall be applicable.”

S.O. 77(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 900(E) Dated:25/04/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, !956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, 
management and operation of NHI50A in the stretch of land from Km [87.70 to Km 98.92 (Venkateshwara Camp to 
Dadesugur Camp Section) in the district of BALLARI in the state of KARNATAKA; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Vijaya Karnataka” and “Deccan 
Herald” both dated 2/07/2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

संतुष्ट होने के बाद “पश्चिम बंगाल राज्य के पूर्वी मेदिनीपुर जिले में राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग- 116 बी नंदकुमार-कौन्टाई-दीघा-

कि.मी.) का पुनर्वास एवं उन्नत कर 2 लेन पक्के शोल्डर्स हेतु राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग -116 बी के नौर्घाट में हल्दी नदि के उपर सेतु 
और इसके पहुँच मार्ग के निर्माण” के सार्वजनिक प्रयोजन के लिए वह भूमि आवश्यक है जिसका संक्षिप्त वर्णन नीचे अनुसुची 
में दिया गया है, इसके द्वारा ऐसी भूमि का अधिग्रहण करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा करती है। 


कोई व्यक्ति, जो उक्त भूमि में हितबद्ध है, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा-3ग की उप-धारा (1) के अधीन 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए एसी भूमि के उपयोग पर सरकारी राजपत्र में इस अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन की तारीख से 
इक्कीस दिनों के भीतर आक्षेप कर सकेगा। 


ऐसा प्रत्येक आक्षेप सक्षम प्राधिकारी, अर्थात्‌, विषेश भुमि अर्जन अधिकारी, जिला अधिकारी का कार्यालय, जिला

लिखित रूप में किया जायेगा और उसमें उसके आधार अधिकथित किए जाएंगे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी आक्षेपकर्ता को 
व्यक्तिगत रूप में या किसी विधि व्यवसायी द्वारा सुने जाने का अवसर देगा और ऐसे सभी आक्षेपों की सुनवाई तथा जाँच 
करने के पश्चात्‌, (यदि कोई हो), जिसे सक्षम प्राधिकारी आवश्यक समझे, आदेश द्वारा या तो आक्षेपों की अनुमोदन या 
अस्वीकार कर सकेगा।

New Delhi, the 8th March, 2024 


S.O. 1172(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by the Sub-Section (i) of Section 3A of the National 
Highways Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being 
satisfied that for the public purpose, the land the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required 
for "Construction of New Bridge at Norghat over River Haldi along with approaches including LA in 
connection with Rehabilitation and Upgradation To 2-Lane with Paved Shoulders Configuration of 
Nandakumar-Contai-Digha-Chandaneshwar Road (0.000 Km To 90.775 Km) along with Contai Bye-Pass 


(3.30km) (Total Length — 94.075 Km) of NH-116B in the State of West Bengal", hereby declares its intention to 
acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one (21) days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Special Land Acquisition Officer, 
Office of the District Magistrate & Collector, Purba Medinipur, Village-Ganapatinagar, P.O. Uttar Sonamui, P.S. 
Tamluk, District- Purba Medinipur, PIN-721648 in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent 
Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, 
after hearing all such objections and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks 
necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

वाणिज्यिक वाहनों के उपयोग के लिए कोई सर्विस रोड अथवा वैकल्पिक सड़क उपलब्ध न हो। 


7. जो यांत्रिक वाहन अपनी श्रेणी के लिए निर्धारित अनुज्ञेय भार की अपेक्षा अधिक भार से लदा हुआ होगा उसके 
चालक अथवा मालिक अथवा प्रभारी व्यक्ति को ऐसे अधिक भार से लदे हुए वाहन को राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग में प्रवेश कराने के 
लिए शुल्क संग्रहण एजेंसी को उक्त नियमों के नियम 10 के उप नियम 1 ए में विनिर्दिष्ट के बराबर शुल्क का भुगतान करना 
होगा और उसे राजमार्ग खण्ड का उपयोग करने की तब तक अनुमति नहीं होगी जब तक कि ऐसे यांत्रिक वाहन से अधिक 
भार को हटा न दिया जाए। 


8. यांत्रिक वाहनों की श्रेणी, उनके लिए अनुज्ञेय भार, छूट-प्राप्त वाहनों की श्रेणी, सर्विस रोड, वैकल्पिक सड़क आदि 
सहित सभी परिभाषाएं नियमों में विनिर्दिष्ट परिभाषाओं के अनुसार होंगी।

9. उक्त नियमों के नियम 12 के अनुसार, उपयोगकर्ताओं की जानकारी के लिए शुल्क की दरों को प्रदर्शित किया 
जाएगा। 


10. ऊपर सारणी-1 में यथा-उल्लिखित, आधार वर्ष 2007-08 के लिए प्रति किलोमीटर शुल्क की आधार दर के 
आधार पर, यांत्रिक वाहनों से लिए जाने वाले वास्तविक शुल्क और छूट की गणना राजमार्ग परियोजना के पूरे कर लिए 
भाग की लम्बाई के आधार पर प्राधिकरण द्वारा की जायेगी। उसे प्राधिकरण द्वारा रियायतग्राही के माध्यम से अंग्रेजी और 
स्थानीय भाषा के कम-से-कम एक समाचार पत्र में प्रकाशित करवाया जाएगा और तत्पश्चात उक्त नियमों के नियम 5 के 
अनुसार उसमें वार्षिक तौर पर संशोधन किया जाएगा।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 8th March, 2024 


S.O. 1174(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 1098(E) Dated:09/03/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the 
Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and 
operation of NH169A in the stretch of land from Km 2.00 to Km15.98 (Thirthahalli-Megaravalli Section) in the 
district of SHIVAMOGGA in the state of KARNATAKA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Samyuktha Karnataka” and 
“The Hindu” both dated 16th December 2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


10 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 1176(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 1899(E) तारीख 25/04/2023, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग I, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा कर्नाटक राज्य के रायचूर जिले में NH150A के 
किमी 187.70 से किमी 198.92 (वेंकटेश्वर कैंप से डेडसुगुर कैंप सेक्शन) के निर्माण (चौड़ीकरण/पेग्ड शोल्डर सहित 2- 
लेन/4-लेन का बनाना आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट 
भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "21/07/2023 " 
को "विजयवाणी" और "टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ;

की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 8th March, 2024 


S.O. 1176(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 1899(E) Dated:25/04/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (1) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the 
Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), 
maintenance, management and operation of NH150A in the stretch of land from Km 187.70 to Km 198.92 
(Venkateshwara Camp to Dadesugur Camp Section) in the district of RAICHUR in the state of KARNATAKA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Vijayavani” and “Times of 
India” both dated 21/07/2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

settled the same appropriately;

submitted its report to the Central Government;

conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 


specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 8th March, 2024 


S.O. 1180(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 5264(E) Dated:11/12/2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/ two lane with paved shoulders/ four laning etc.), maintenance, 
management and operation of NH167BG in the stretch of land from Km. 36.400 to Km. 45.600 of Duttalur to Kavali 
secion in the district of SPSR Nellore in the state of ANDHRA PRADESH; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Andhra Prabha” and “Times of 
India” both dated 15.12.2023 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas no objection has been received from any person by the Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 1175(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 1372(E) तारीख 22/03/2023, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग 1, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) A प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा आंध्र प्रदेश राज्य के अल्लुरी सीतारामा राजू जिले 
में अराकू (भल्लुगुडा) से बोवदारा राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग 516ई के कि.मी. 51.772 से कि.मी. 92.755 तक के भूखण्ड पर के 
निर्माण, (चौड़ीकरण/पेग्ड शोल्डर सहित 2-लेन/ का बनाना आदि) अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना 
से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "24.03.2023 " 
को "आंध्र प्रभा" और "द हिंदू" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


1685 GI/2024 (1) 


2 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 8th March, 2024 
S.O. 1178(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 4476 Dated:12/10/2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for (Widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.), maintenance 


Management and operation of NH333A in the stretch of land from Km. 189 to Km. 190.23 (District Land Aquisition 
Office, District Magistrate Office,Godda) in the district of Godda in the state of JHARKHAND;

And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Jagran” and “Hindustan” 
both dated 12.11.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

के कि.मी. 53.440 से कि.मी.95.700 (डिप्टी कमिश्नर ऑफिस , उखरुल) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चोड़ाकरने / 
चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि 
का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 29 फ़रवरी , 
2024 को ” संगाई एक्सप्रेस' और ”ह्युयेन लानपाओ” दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

अपनी रिपोर्ट दे दी है ; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 
3घ की उपधारा (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है 
कि इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 8th March, 2024 


S.O. 1179(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 5265(E) Dated:11/12/2023 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.), maintenance, 
management and operation of NH167BG in the stretch of land from Km. 45.600 to Km. 107.224 of Duttalur to Kavali 
section in the district of SPSR Nellore in the state of ANDHRA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Andhra Prabha” and “Times Of 
India ” both dated 15.12.2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 1193(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. का.आ. 1345(अ) तारीख 21/03/2023, 5.0.10(8) 
तारीख 29/12/2023, जो भारत के राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग Ul, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा 
मेघालय राज्य के ईस्ट गारो fees जिले में NH127B के कि.मी. 0 से कि.मी.36.635 (दारुगिरी से विलियमनगर जंक्शन) 
तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस 
अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और जबकि उक्त अधिसूचना का सार 18 अप्रैल, 2023 को "द शिलांग टाइम्स1" और "सैलेंटिनी जनेरा2" दोनों में 
प्रकाशित किया गया है; उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3ए की उपधारा (3) के तहत; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 8th March, 2024 


S.O. 1193(E).—In—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road 
Transport and Highways, S.0.1345 (E) Dated:21/03/2023, S.O.10(E) Dated:29/12/2023 , published in the Gazette of 
India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National 
Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its 
intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four- 
laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation of NH127B in the stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 36.635 
(Darugiri to Williamnagar Junction) in the district of East Garo Hills in the state of MEGHALAYA 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Shillong TimesZ” and 
“Salantini Janera2” both dated 18th April,2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

No. B/RR/2023-RIMS:.—In exercise of the powers conferred under Rule 3(ii) of the Bye-Laws of the 
Regional Institute of Medical Sciences, Imphal, Manipur and in pursuance of the approval of the Ministry of Health & 
Family Welfare conveyed vide letter No. U-12015/17/2017-NE-Part dated 03-10-2023, the Chairman, Executive 
Council, Society of Regional Institute of Medical Sciences, Imphal hereby makes the following rules regulating the 
method of recruitment to the post of Assistant Professor (Health Education & Family Welfare) Non-Medical in 
Regional Institute of Medical Sciences, Imphal. 


1. Short title and commencement.- 


(i) These rules may be called the Regional Institute of Medical Sciences, Imphal, Assistant Professor (Health 
Education & Family Welfare) Non-Medical (Group 'A' post) Recruitment Rules, 2023. 


(ii) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Number of post, classification, level in pay matrix- The number of the said post, its classification and level in pay 
matrix, shall be as specified in columns (2) to (4) of the Schedule annexed to these rules. 


3. Method of recruitment, age Limit, qualifications, etc.- The method of recruitment, age limit, qualifications and 
other matters relating to the said post shall be as specified in columns (5) to (13) of the said Schedule. 


4. Disqualification.- No Person,- 
(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 


(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, shall be eligible for 
appointment to the said post: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal 
law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt 
any person from the operation of this rule. 


5. Power to relax. - where the central Government is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it may, 
by order and for reasons to be recorded in writing, relax any of the provisions of these rules with respect to any class 
or category of persons. 


6. Saving. - Nothing in these rules shall affect reservation, relaxation of age limit and other concessions required to be 
provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, the Other Backward Classes, the Ex-servicemen or any other 
special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time in this 
regard.

MINISTRY OF MICRO, SMALL AND MEDIUM ENTERPRISES 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 8th March, 2024 


G.S.R. 66(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-clauses | and 2 of Clause 24 of the Rules and 
Regulations of the Memorandum of Association of Mahatma Gandhi Institute for Rural Industrialization (MGIRD, 
and with the approval of the Central Government, the Executive Council of Mahatma Gandhi Institute for Rural 
Industrialization hereby makes the following rules regulating the method of recruitment to the Group ‘A’, ‘B’ and ‘C’ 
posts in the Mahatma Gandhi Institute for Rural Industrialization (MGIRIJ) as under:- 


l. Short title and commencement. —() These rules may be called the Mahatma Gandhi Institute for Rural 
Industrialization Group ‘A’, ‘B’ & ‘C’ Officers and Staff Recruitment Rules, 2024. (2) They shall come into force on 
the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2. Application.— These rules shall apply to the posts specified in column (l) of the Schedule annexed to these rules. 


3. Number of posts, classification and pay band, grade pay or pay scale. - The number of the said posts, their 
classification and the pay band, grade pay or pay scale attached thereto shall be as specified in column (2) to (4) of the 
said Schedule. 


4. Method of recruitment, age limit and other qualifications.-The method of recruitment to the said posts, age 
limits and qualifications and other matters relating thereto shall be as specified in columns (5) to (3) of the said 
Schedule. 


5. Initial constitutions. — () Group ‘A’, ‘B’ and ‘C’ Officers and Staff working on regular establishment in MGIRI 
on the date of commencement of these rules shall be deemed to have been duly appointed to the corresponding posts 
which they were holding on regular basis on that date. (2) The inter-se seniority of officials who are appointed at the 
initial constitution shall be determined as per the date of their regular appointment to respective grades subject to the 
condition that their inter-se seniority within their respective grades shall not be disturbed. (3) The regular continuous 
service of officers mentioned in Sub-rule (l) prior to their appointment at the initial constitution under these rules, 
shall count for the purpose of probation period, the qualifying service for promotion, confirmation and pension. 


6. Disqualification. - No person, - 


(a) who has entered into or contracted a marriage with a person having a spouse living; or 


20 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(i)] 


(b) who, having a spouse living, has entered into or contracted a marriage with any person, shall be eligible for 
appointment to the said posts: 


Provided that the Central Government may, if satisfied that such marriage is permissible under the personal 
law applicable to such person and the other party to the marriage and that there are other grounds for so doing, exempt 
any person from the operation of this rule. 


7. Power to relax. - Where the autonomous body is of the opinion that it is necessary or expedient so to do, it may, 
by order, and for reasons to be recorded in writing, with prior approval of the Central Government relax any 
provisions of these rules with respect to any class or category of persons. 


8. Savings. - Nothing in these rules shall affect reservations, relaxation of age limit and other concessions required to 
be provided for the Scheduled Castes, the Scheduled Tribes, the Other Backward Classes, the Ex-servicemen and 
other special categories of persons in accordance with the orders issued by the Central Government from time to time 
in this regard.

New Delhi, the 11th March, 2024 


G.S.R. 172(E).— In exercise of the powers conferred by section 18 of the Citizenship Act, 1955 (57 of 
1955), the Central Government hereby makes the following rules to further amend the Citizenship Rules, 2009, 
namely:- 


1. Short title and commencement. - (1) These rules may be called the Citizenship (Amendment) Rules, 2024. 
(2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette. 


2५ In the Citizenship Rules, 2009 (hereinafter referred to as the said rules), after rule 10, the following rule shall 
be inserted, namely: - 


“10A. = Application for grant of citizenship by registration or naturalisation by persons eligible under 
section 6B.- (1) An application from a person eligible under section 6B, for grant of citizenship by registration 
or naturalisation, shall not be entertained unless- 


(a) the application from a person of Indian origin for registration as a citizen of India fulfilling 
the conditions under clause (a) of sub-section (1) of section 5, is submitted in Form ITA and 
is in accordance with rule 4 except clauses (a) and (b) of the said rule; or 


(b) the application from a person who is married to a citizen of India, for registration as a 
citizen of India fulfilling the conditions under clause (c) of sub-section (1) of section 5, is 
submitted in Form IIIA and is in accordance with rule 5 except clauses (a) and (b) of sub- 
rule (1) of the said rule; or 


(c) the application from a person who is a minor child of a person who is a citizen of India, for 
registration as a citizen of India fulfilling the conditions under clause (d) of sub-section (1) 
of section 5, is submitted in Form IVA and is in accordance with rule 6 except clause (a) of 
the said rule; or 


(d) the application from a person whose parents are registered as citizens of India, for 
registration as a citizen of India fulfilling the conditions under clause (e) of sub-section (1) 
of section 5, is submitted in Form VA and is in accordance with rule 7 except clauses (a) 
and (b) of the said rule; or 


(e) the application from a person who or either of his parents was a citizen of Independent 
India, for registration as a citizen of India fulfilling the conditions under clause (f) of sub- 
section (1) of section 5, is submitted in Form VIA and is in accordance with rule 8 except 
clauses (a) and (b) of the said rule; or 


(f) the application from a person who is registered as an Overseas Citizen of India Cardholder, 
for registration as a citizen of India fulfilling the conditions under clause (g) of sub-section 
(1) of section 5, is submitted in Form VIIA and is in accordance with rule 9 except clauses 
(a) and (b) of the said rule; or

(g) the application from a person for grant of citizenship by naturalisation fulfilling the 
qualifications for naturalisation under the provisions of the Third Schedule, is submitted in 
Form VINA which includes- 


(i) an affidavit verifying the correctness of the statements made in the application 
along with an affidavit from an Indian citizen testifying the character of the 
applicant; and 


(ii) a declaration from the applicant that he has adequate knowledge of one of the 
languages as specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution. 


Explanation.—The applicant shall be considered to have adequate knowledge of the 
concerned language if he can speak or read or write that language. 


(2) Every application made by the applicant under sub-rule (1) shall have a declaration to the effect that 
the citizenship of his country shall stand renounced irrevocably in the event of his application being approved 
and that he shall not raise any claim on it in future. 


(3) Every application made under this rule shall be accompanied by — 
(a) acopy of any one of the documents specified in Schedule IA; 
(0) acopy of any one of the documents specified in Schedule IB; and 
(c) an affidavit in format specified in Schedule IC. ”. 
In the said rules, after rule 11, the following rule shall be inserted, namely:- 


“114, Authority to which application may be made by a person applying under section 6B.- 
(1) An application for registration or naturalisation under section 6B shall be submitted by the 
applicant in electronic form to the Empowered Committee through the District Level Committee as 
may be notified by the Central Government. 


(2) On submission of the application, an acknowledgment in Form IX shall be generated 
electronically. 


(3) The District Level Committee headed by Designated Officer, as may be specified, shall 
verify the documents submitted by the applicant along with the application. 


(4) 16 Designated Officer shall administer to the applicant the oath of allegiance as specified in 
the Second Schedule to the Citizenship Act, 1955 (57 of 1955) and thereafter, sign the oath of 
allegiance and forward the same in electronic form along with confirmation regarding verification of 
documents to the Empowered Committee. 


(5) In case an applicant fails to appear in person to subscribe the application and take oath of 
allegiance despite giving reasonable opportunities, the District Level Committee shall forward such

(1) के अधीन जारी भारत सरकार के पेट्रोलियम और प्राकृतिक गैस मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 3445(अ) 
तारीख 25.07.2023 द्वारा उस अधिसूचना से संलग्न अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि में गेल (इण्डिया) लिमिटेड द्वारा 
तमिलनाडु राज्य में कोच्चि-कुट्टनाड-बेंगलुरू- मंगलुरु पाइपलाइन (केकेबीएमपीएल) के माध्यम से प्राकृतिक गैस के परिवहन 
के लिए पाइपलाइन बिछाने के प्रयोजन के लिए उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी; 


और उक्त राजपत्रित अधिसूचना की प्रतियां जनता को उपलब्ध करा दी गई थी; 


और, सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 की उप-धारा (1) के अधीन भारत सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 


और भारत सरकार ने, उक्त रिपोर्ट पर विचार करने के पश्चात और यह संतुष्ट हो जाने पर कि उक्त भूमि 
पाइपलाइनें बिछाने के लिए अपेक्षित है, उस में उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन करने का विनिश्चय किया है;

New Delhi, the ]lth March, 2024 


S.O. 222(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 5525 Dated:29/2/2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of Western Bypass in the stretch of land from Km. 20.87 to Km. 40.4 (Hatod) in the District of INDORE in the State 
of MADHYA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Bhaskar” and “Free Press” 
both dated !.0.2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

असाधारण, भाग ॥, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (ii) A प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा तेलंगाना राज्य के जागतिअल जिले में NHG3 के 
कि.मी. 55 से कि.मी.69.25 (आरमूर-जगित्याल-मंचेरियल सेक्शन) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चोड़ाकरने / चार 
लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "8 अप्रैल 2023" 
को "नमस्तेतेलंगाना (तेलुगु दैनिक)" और "दहिंदू (अंग्रेजी दैनिक)" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (॥) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ;

इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the ]lth March, 2024 


S.O. 223(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 5523 Dated:29/2/2023, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 
referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of Western Bypass in the stretch of land from Km. 8.8 to Km. 20.87 (Depalpur) in the District of INDORE in the State 
of MADHYA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Dainik Bhaskar” and “Free Press” 
both dated .0.2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 


submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 


vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

(1) के अधीन जारी भारत सरकार के पेट्रोलियम और प्राकृतिक गैस मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.अ. 4836(अ) 


तारीख 26.10.2023 द्वारा उस अधिसूचना से संलग्न अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि में गेल (इण्डिया) लिमिटेड द्वारा ओडिसा 
राज्य में धामरा- हल्दिया पाइप लाइन (डी एच पी एल) के माध्यम से प्राकृतिक गैस के परिवहन के लिए पाइपलाइन 
बिछाने के प्रयोजन के लिए उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी; 


और उक्त राजपत्रित अधिसूचना की प्रतियां जनता को उपलब्ध करा दी गई थी; 


और, सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 6 की उप-धारा (1) के अधीन भारत सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 


और भारत सरकार ने, उक्त रिपोर्ट पर विचार करने के पश्चात और यह संतुष्ट हो जाने पर कि उक्त भूमि 
पाइपलाइनें बिछाने के लिए अपेक्षित है, उस में उपयोग के अधिकार का अर्जन करने का विनिश्चय किया है;

S.O. 1210(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 

Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building

the stretch of land from Km. 0.00 to Km. 55.00 (District Land Acquisition Office , Collectorate , Gaya , Bihar) in the 


district of GAYA in the state of BIHAR, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 


section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, District Land Acquisition Officer, 
Gaya, Bihar in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an 
opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and 
after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 


disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 
The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

कि.मी. 0 से कि.मी. 30.093 (जोधपुर) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ा करने/चार लेन का बनाने, आदि),

आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 

और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "45.42.2023" 
को "राजस्थान पत्रिका" और "दैनिक नवज्योति" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ;

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the llth March, 2024 


S.O. 22(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, Number S.0.558(E) dated: 06/02/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, 
Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four/six-laning, etc.), maintenance, management 
and operation of NH334 D in the stretch of land from Km. 0.000 to Km. 58.600 (Aligarh-Palwal Section) in the 
District of ALIGARH in the state of UTTAR PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Times of India (English)” 
and “Navbharat Times (Hindi)” both dated l0/02/2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the 
competent authority has submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

New Delhi, the 11th March, 2024 


S.O. 1241(E).— Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 26 Dated:29/12/2023 & 547 Dated:05/02/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part

1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land 
specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, 
management and operation of Delhi Ludhiana Amritsar Katra Expressway (NH No. NE5) from Km.503.200. to Km. 
514+300 along the existing NH44 from Km 86.7 to Km 96 in the district SAMBA of the UT of J&K; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Daily Excelsior” and “Danik 
Savera” both dated 06 January 2024, & 13 February 2024 under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

New Delhi, the ]lth March, 2024 


S.O. 242(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 207 Dated:7/0/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part I, Section 3, Sub- 
section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter 


[भाग Ive 3(ii)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण ]7 


referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH-27 in the stretch of land from Km. 5.945 to Km. 25.89 in the district of DARRANG in the state of ASSAM 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Amar Asom” in Assamese 
Language and “The Assam Tribune” in English Language both dated 23 January 2024; under sub-section (3) of 
section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for construction of Toll Plaza Maintenance, management and operation of NH248A in 
the stretch of land from Km. 0.0 to Km. 36.810 (Shahpura-Alwar section) in the district of JAIPUR in the state of 
RAJASTHAN. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Times of India ” and “Dainik 


Bhaskar” both dated 07.02.2024 & 09.02.2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 


settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 


submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 


specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

का.आ. 1217(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 531 तारीख 05/02/2024, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग 1, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा मध्य प्रदेश राज्य के बुरहानपुर जिले में NH753L 
के कि.मी. 145.027 से कि.मी. 147.608 और कि.मी. 149.565 से कि.मी. 151.779 तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण 
(चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में 
विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "14.02.2024" 
को "टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया" और "दैनिक भास्कर" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


1747 01/2024 (1) 


2 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी

New Delhi, the 11th March, 2024 


S.O. 1217(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways, 531 Dated:05/02/2024 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 3, Sub-

referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in the Schedule 
annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and operation 
of NH753L in the stretch of land from Km. 145.027 to Km. 147.608 and from Km. 149.565 to Km. 151.779 in the 
district of BURHANPUR in the state ofp MADHYA PRADESH 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Times of India” and “Dainik 
Bhaskar” both dated 14.02.2024; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act;

And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 
settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

—Gramsir, Thopgram, Chakitwa Kanhai Danga, Ramnagar, Narayanpur, Baikunthpur, Satrampur, Maslandpur, 
Mahatapur, Abratola, Nurpur, Ashanpur,Mirjapur 155, Mirjapur 154/156, Sirasin, Chanddighi, Madhupur, Bajardipur, 
Abhirampur Anchal - Barharwa in the district of SAHIBGANJ in the state of JHARKHAND.

“Dainik Jagran (Hindi)” and “Hindustan (English)” both dated 07/04/2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of 
the said Act;

settled the same appropriately;

vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

कि.मी. 0 से कि.मी. 27.45 (असिस्टेंट कमिश्नर कुमता) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चोड़ाकरने / चार लेन का 
बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन 
करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "20-05-2023" 
को "द टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया " और "विजयवाणी" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया;

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (॥) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की STAT (॥) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

of NH766E in the stretch of land from Km. 0 to Km. 27.5 (Assistant Commissioner Kumta) in the district of UTTAR

And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Times of India” and 


“Vijayavani” both dated 20-05-2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas the Competent Authority has received objections filed under Section 3-C, considered and 


settled the same appropriately; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 


submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 


specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose;

का.आ. 1244(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 3208(अ) तारीख 18 जुलाई, 2023, जो भारत के राजपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग 1, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा बिहार राज्य के भागलपुर जिले में एन एच 133ई 
के कि.मी. 0 से कि.मी.11.735 तक के सड़क निर्माण (चौडीकरण/पेग्ड शोल्डर सहित 2-लेन/4-लेन का बनाने आदि), 
अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने 
आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "22 अगस्त 
2023" को "प्रभात खबर" और तारीख "29 अगस्त 2023" को "दैनिक भास्कर" में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 

जबकि सक्षम प्राधिकारी को धारा 3-ग के तहत दायर आपत्ति प्राप्त हुई है, जिस पर विचार किया गया है और 
उसका उचित रूप से निपटान किया गया; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है ;

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

New Delhi, the 11th March, 2024 


9.0. 1244(E).—Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road 
Transport and Highways, number S.O. 3208(E) Dated 18th July 2023, published in the Gazette of India, 
Extraordinary, Part I, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to 
acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for road construction (widening/two lane 
with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH133E in the stretch of land from 
Km. 0 to Km. 11.735 in the district of BHAGALPUR in the state of BIHAR; 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Prabhat Khabar” dated 22nd 
August 2023 and “Dainik Bhaskar” dated 29th August 2023; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act;
